abstract: The World Economic Forum's Future of Jobs Report 2024 examines employer expectations for labor market transformation over the next five years. The report finds that nearly a quarter of all jobs are expected to undergo change, with technology and economic shifts driving both job displacement and creation, resulting in a net decline of 2-4% of total roles globally.
keyFindings: Employers expect 23% of jobs to change within the next five years
Net job decline of 2-4% of total roles is anticipated once job creation offsets displacement
